subject: Re: MAP alignment — staggered close windows & risk acceptance
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@arcengineering.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Hardy <mike.hardy@arcengineering.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood pilot — request to shift final acceptance window

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. The pilot team ran overnight on the small data slice and found two test cases that require an additional data-retention verification and a long‑tail prompts pass. Our internal evaluation lead (Mike) estimates that will add ~10 business days to the test plan.

We still want to move forward — the product fit is good — but we need to push the formal close (signed SOW + procurement) out from 11/30 to 12/13. Procurement will also need a clean copy of the term sheet and the evaluation checklist you promised.

Attaching our checklist for context. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a staggered acceptance (core features by 12/13, extended evals by 12/20) and whether any pricing or credit adjustments are possible if the final sign happens after the quarter?

Best,
Sarah Collins
Director, Platform Engineering
Arc Engineering

Attachment: arc_eval_notes_v1.docx (referenced)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@arcengineering.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — request to shift final acceptance window

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for the clear ask. We can support a staggered acceptance approach. Proposed immediate steps: 

- Redwood delivers updated MAP (staggered milestones) and the evaluation_checklist.xlsx by EOD 11/25.
- Core acceptance milestone: 2027-12-13 (production readiness for core features).
- Extended eval milestone: 2027-12-20 (long-tail test completion).
- We will keep the quoted commercial terms intact but need procurement to confirm PO timing.

Karthik, Monica — please review pricing/credits for slipping outside the quarter. Rishi — can you confirm whether the additional data-retention verification affects our SOC/compliance packaging or evidence turnaround?

I will schedule a 30-minute sync for Friday to lock the MAP.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0247

Attachment: request_received.txt

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@arcengineering.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — request to shift final acceptance window

Vanessa / Sarah — quick commercial note: if the signed SOW moves into the next fiscal month, the deal will miss our quarter target. I can authorize a 5% one-time credit (non-recurring) to keep the economic footprint consistent for the first invoice period, but anything larger requires VP approval.

Proposed language we can use in the MAP: "If final execution occurs after 2027-11-30, Redwood will apply a one-time non-recurring onboarding credit of 5% on month 1 invoice."

If that works for Arc, I'll prep the term sheet with that clause.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@arcengineering.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@arcengineering.com>, Mike Hardy <mike.hardy@arcengineering.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — request to shift final acceptance window

Thanks, Karthik — 5% credit is reasonable and should be acceptable to procurement, but they will need the clause in the term sheet and a clean procurement_term_sheet.pdf. Procurement asked whether the staggered acceptance will change any SLAs or support scope during the extended eval — they prefer a written note that core features will be supported at production SLAs starting 12/13.

I'll review the updated MAP in the sync tomorrow.

Best,
Sarah

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@arcengineering.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation: approval request for 5% onboarding credit and MAP acceptance wording

Jonas — looping you in because the depletion of our quarter bookings is visible if this deal slips. Summary of risk: 

- Risk ID 1: Close date slip from 2027-11-30 -> 2027-12-13 (probable). Impact: pushes revenue into next fiscal period.
- Risk ID 2: Procurement needs explicit SLA confirmation for staggered acceptance window. Impact: procurement delay if not captured.
- Proposed mitigations:
  - Offer one-time, non-recurring 5% onboarding credit (Karthik can sign off within AE limits).
  - Commit in writing that core features will be supported to production SLAs starting 12/13; extended eval support is limited to business-hours response until 12/20.
  - Updated MAP attached (updated_map_v2.xlsx) with milestone owners and due dates.

Request: sign-off to proceed with the 5% credit and the above MAP language. If approved, I will send the procurement_term_sheet.pdf and DocuSign link to Sarah/procurement.

Thanks — appreciate quick turnaround on this.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@arcengineering.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: approval request for 5% onboarding credit and MAP acceptance wording

Vanessa — approved. Authorize the one-time 5% onboarding credit; include the clause proposed by Karthik. Confirmed: Redwood will support core features at production SLAs as of 2027-12-13. Extended-eval support will be business-hours only until 2027-12-20.

Action items for closing the loop: 
- Vanessa: send procurement_term_sheet.pdf and DocuSign link to Arc procurement by EOD 11/30.
- Karthik: update HubSpot with the credit clause and new close date; mark deal stage as "Staggered Acceptance".
- Monica / Rishi: ensure SOC evidence and data-retention note are attached to procurement packet.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Thread summary (internal) :
- Finalized mitigations and approved 5% onboarding credit to absorb quarter slippage.
- MAP re-baselined: core acceptance 2027-12-13, extended eval 2027-12-20.
- Procurement packet (procurement_term_sheet.pdf + SOC evidence) and DocuSign sent to Arc; risk logged under ARC-2027-11-V1 in HubSpot.
---
thread_content_summary: Arc Engineering requested a 2-week extension to the evaluation window which would move the SOW signature out of the quarter. Team agreed to a staggered MAP and authorized a one-time 5% onboarding credit; VP approved and requested procurement paperwork and SOC evidence. MAP re-baselined and actions assigned.
